name: Ruzzgot remembers the road · Booty Bay docks, Stranglethorn Vale
interpretationNote: Original interpretive environment art for Booty Bay docks, Stranglethorn Vale. Target reference: original pre-Cataclysm World of Warcraft Classic Booty Bay docks, Stranglethorn Vale. Preserve recognizable traits: Classic Booty Bay: tropical green water, layered wooden buildings on stilts, crowded boardwalks, moored ships, weathered cranes and lush jungle behind the harbor. Not a screenshot, exact in-game map, surveyed route, mine floorplan or proof of character co-presence. Side-by-side comparison against the matching Classic area remains a human review gate.
